summary: Premium adds Fast play to Tower Defense, so players with a strong tower can spend less time waiting for waves they already know they will win.

features.title: Game speed
features.short: Run the game up to three times faster
features.description: A speed button on the game page switches between normal, double and triple speed. It is the same game with the same score, only with less waiting.

features.title: Auto waves
features.short: Start the next waves by themselves
features.description: Once you have a record, you choose up to which wave the next wave starts on its own instead of waiting in the shop, up to the furthest wave you have already reached.

features.title: Owner switch
features.short: Turn Fast play on or off for players
features.description: The owner of the server decides from the game's window in the desktop whether players get Fast play. It is on by default.
